## Description of Changes
Please include a summary of the changes, bug fixes, or new builder capabilities introduced.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds mod capabilities)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing schemas/mods to not compile)
- [ ] Documentation update

## Minecraft Verification
- [ ] Bedrock `.mcaddon` generation verified
- [ ] Java Fabric `.jar` generation verified
- [ ] Pydantic schemas validated

## Testing Checklist
- [ ] All automated unit & integration tests pass (`pytest tests/ -v`)
- [ ] No sensitive tokens or secrets committed
- [ ] Code formatted and compliant with security rules
